objective: The rainbow coat (decision 0058): any hatch has a small chance (1 in 200) to come out in a rainbow coat, a second texture for the same model, painted for every animal and variant. The coat adds 5% to every stat, rounded up.
acceptance_criteria: A hatch from any egg comes out rainbow 1 time in 200, whatever the animal or variant; every one of its stats is 5% higher than the same animal's without the coat, rounded up, at every level and in fights
A rainbow animal shows its coat on the ranch, in a fight and in its pictures, and is named Rainbow on its card and when it hatches
The coat is saved with the animal; old saves load unchanged
The server decides the coat; a client cannot ask for one (the admin's menu apart)
verification: Lune 693/693 (with the bonus: 5% more of every stat, rounded up, at levels 0, 1, 35 and 70; exact where 5% is whole), stylua and selene clean. CI run 43809671430 passed on pull request 25. Studio: local build, stamp `dev` (no CI stamp), 2026-11-16. The 24 coats painted from the uploaded models' own files and uploaded in upload-assets run 43804783464 (the four eggs, the three lions and 24 rainbow coats, all succeeded); cards of six were inspected (`docs/concepts/rainbow-family.png`). Specs: about 1 hatch in 200 is rainbow (60 to 140 in 20,000), with the plain animal's stats; the field is absent on every other animal; it survives buy, start, crack, training and sanitize; junk values are dropped; every animal and variant has a coat and nothing else has. In Studio: all 24 portraits carry their coat's texture; rainbow animals added from the admin's menu (Lion, Crystal Rhino, Star Meerkat, Phoenix Flamingo, Cheetah) walk the ranch in their coats with sparkles, the Crystal Rhino's Neon crystals turning through the colours, the Cheetah keeping its spots (screens); the Animals menu shows the RAINBOW chip. With the chance forced to 1 for one test session (in Studio only, put back after): a Meadow Egg bought and opened gave 'You hatched a Rainbow Jackal! (common)', the jackal stepped out of the nest in its coat, and it fought wave 1 in the arena in the same coat. A coat's texture can take a moment to arrive, like any texture: the animal is plain grey for that moment. The bonus was added after the Studio session and is checked by its spec only, not in a fight. Not checked: a rainbow hatch at the real chance, the card under the cursor, the pictures of a rainbow animal in the Waves menu, phones, two players, whether 1 in 200 feels right.
notes: SHANNON on 2026-11-16: 'add a rainbow texture that has a small chance to apply to any animal on hatch', then '1 in 200 is good give them a 5% stat increase to all stats'. The bonus is rounded up so that small stats gain too (a stat of 8 becomes 9, which is more than 5%): say if it should round down instead.
